text_block_list.text:
Since Sirius Symboli wasn't feeling well,
I took her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal.
Just sit tight and wait.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Where is this...?
...An internet cafe?
(――*bzzzt!*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm, there's something on the monitor—

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text:
"‘Well, well, how are you finding the accommodations?
O, captive wolf!’"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to have you play a fun game!
The rules are simple!"

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text: "All you have to do is solve the many riddles hidden in this space and escape!"

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text:
"‘However—
if you can't escape in time, you lose!
An unimaginable tragedy awaits you!’"

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe, HAHAHAHA!!
And now—let the delightful show begin!!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Haa.
Quite a cliché topic, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Solve the riddles to find the key,
is that the deal—?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no rule saying
I gotta play it by the book, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then—it's simple.
—...*inhale*.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!
(WHAM!! BAM!! CRACKKK!!!)

text_block_list.name: Person in Black Mask
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-WHAAAATTTT!!?!
The door was smashed open with a kick, you sayyyy!!?!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I intended to finish it
in a single kick, but oh well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's find the way back—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just a dream after all, huh?
...Well, whatever. I feel refreshed.

Did she have a good dream?
Sirius Symboli wore
a strangely refreshed expression.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hah!!
(—*clack!*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So kicking won't work on 'em, huh.
...What a pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What, so it really was a dream?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wasted way too much brainpower
on that riddle crap... Tch.

Whether troubled by a bad dream or something else,
a shadow hung over Sirius Symboli's face...
